rationale: Mufaddal's deep embedded systems and IoT expertise—particularly in firmware, connectivity, and real-time software architecture—complements Braillic's need to scale their ArNav surgical navigation platform with additional embedded and systems engineering talent. As CTO, Stiven is actively hiring engineers to support FDA compliance and product development; Mufaddal's automotive-grade embedded Linux and OTA update experience directly addresses the reliability and regulatory rigor required for medical device software.
intro_message: mufaddal.esmael@gmail.com, meet Stiven Ding (CTO at Braillic) — Stiven is building AR surgical navigation software and hiring embedded engineers; your automotive-grade firmware and embedded systems background could be valuable as they scale toward FDA submission.
